correctness.rationale: Exact Schatten-four identity reduces every complex 2x2 matrix to balanced offdiagonal magnitudes by a monotonic comparison in their squared-sum parameter. The remaining real two-variable ratio is minimized in the killed diagonal coordinate by a strictly convex quartic, with a unique positive stationary root of t^3+4t^2+3t-1 and verified endpoint decay. Triangle-containing masks compress to this sharp 2x2 witness; triangle-free masks decompose into disjoint all-one rectangles and their block projections are Schatten-four contractions. All quantifiers, scalar field, and infinite-block extension are explicit. The packed standard-library checker validates polynomial identities and independent finite witnesses but the proof is analytic.

originality.rationale: An exact S4 norm evaluates the very 2x2 triangle-mask quantity that Banks–Harcharras explicitly left open for 2<p<infinity in their 2004 original paper. The resulting sharp global gap does not follow from their positivity result. Doust–Gillespie address boundedness and contractive patterns, and Levene treats the B(l2) (S-infinity) norm. published-finding corpus searches for the exact mask, algebraic polynomial, Schur idempotent norm gap, and related aliases gave no exact same-claim or dominating result. Bibliographic risk remains for an obscure equivalent historical formulation.
residual_risks: The 2001 Doust short proceedings contribution was inaccessible in full; abstract and subsequent 2004 open question strongly suggest but do not prove noncoverage.
An equivalent later exact S4 triangle multiplier computation could have appeared under a different matrix-inequality formulation despite targeted searches.

The 2005 Doust–Gillespie full preprint was available but only the most relevant introduction and initial results were materially read; its remaining sections have a low, nonzero residual comparison risk.

value.rationale: The exact first forbidden norm for Schatten-four idempotent Schur multipliers was explicitly singled out as a quantitative problem by Banks–Harcharras. The algebraic constant resolves a natural optimal gap rather than a renamed routine inequality; it gives the sharp uniform stability margin separating all contractive masks from genuinely expansive ones, attained already on the smallest forbidden pattern. This is an infinite-family sharp invariant, not a cherry-picked finite computation.
